common_kit.role: Reusable surfaces, props, overlays, and masks. Puzzle assets may override it.

matrix_skin.surface_policy: Real-room surfaces are clipped by the puzzle region matrix; scene layout never owns cells.
matrix_skin.object_policy: Furniture is placed from a room-use plan, stays off door openings, and never changes solver facts.

boundary_style.policy: Open edges are presentation-only doors, arches, aisles, or stage openings; hover outlines still follow the complete region matrix.

background.usage: asset is optional page atmosphere; board_asset is deterministic programmatic board rendering; board logic remains cell driven
